title: Table rendering: `frame` sets no border width, and the `black` border colour for `rules`/`frame` matches no browser
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard? Two rules in [Rendering, Tables](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#tables-2) do not match any browser. Found while fixing `rules="rows"` in WebKit (https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=257254). ## 1. `frame` gives the table no border width The presentational hints set only the style: > ```css > table[frame=box i], table[frame=border i] { border-style: outset; } > ``` and only the `border` attribute maps to `border-*-width`. So `` gets `medium` (3px). Every browser uses 1px. ```html
x
x
x
``` | | Spec | Safari 27.0 | Firefox 162 | Chrome 160 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `frame="box"` | 3px outset | 1px solid | 1px outset | 1px solid | | `border="5" frame="box"` | 5px outset | 1px solid | 5px outset | 1px solid | | `frame="box" border="5"` | 5px outset | 5px solid | 5px outset | 1px solid | Firefox does it with a UA sheet rule, below the `border` attribute hint ([html.css](https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/source/layout/style/res/html.css)): ```css table[frame] { border: thin hidden; } ``` Proposal: add the width the same way, for the valid values only, to the UA sheet (not the hints, so that `border` still wins): ```css table[frame=void i], table[frame=above i], table[frame=below i], table[frame=hsides i], table[frame=lhs i], table[frame=rhs i], table[frame=vsides i], table[frame=box i], table[frame=border i] { border-width: 1px; } ``` (`solid` instead of `outset` in Safari and Chrome is a browser bug, filed separately for WebKit.) ## 2. The `black` border colour is used by no browser > ```css > table[rules=none i], table[rules=groups i], table[rules=rows i], > table[rules=cols i], table[rules=all i], table[frame=void i], > ... > table[rules=all i] > tfoot > tr > td, table[rules=all i] > tfoot > tr > th { > border-color: black; > } > ``` All three browsers keep `currentcolor` instead: ```html
xx
x
``` | `border-top-color` | Spec | Safari 27.0 | Firefox 162 | Chrome 160 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `rules="all"` table | black | blue | blue | blue | | `rules="all"` cell | black | blue | blue | blue | | `frame="box"` table | black | blue | blue | blue | This is the same situation as `table, td, th { border-color: gray; }`, removed in #4391 because no browser did it. Proposal: remove this rule too. Happy to write the WPT tests for both once there is agreement.
